reasoning: A concentric circle with a solid center dot is the standard UI glyph for a selected radio button or a media record button, and also reads as a minimal bullseye target. Because it is so geometrically simple, it is best used when a more specific icon (like a microphone for audio recording or a dartboard target with an arrow) is unavailable, or for UI/recording tasks.
